clips.title: The story
paras: In Redridge, Magistrate Solomon offers a generous bounty on the warlord behind Blackrock's invasion of Stonewatch. The reward goes to anyone who storms the conquered keep and brings back the commander's severed head.

Gath'Ilzogg commands Blackrock raids across the Redridge Mountains. His orcs stormed Stonewatch Keep and made the former human bastion a fortified staging ground for attacks on nearby settlements. From its highest ramparts, he plans further incursions into Lakeshire, threatening to cut Redridge off from the rest of the kingdom.

Stormwind's royal army has failed to send reinforcements to the border regions, so Magistrate Solomon takes matters into his own hands. Lakeshire lacks the soldiers to retake Stonewatch Keep by force. Solomon posts a public bounty on Gath'Ilzogg, hoping to break Blackrock's leadership and begin reclaiming the keep for the crown.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Wanted! Gath'Ilzogg, Leader of the Blackrock attacks on Stonewatch Keep and raids against the township of Lakeshire.

Gath'Ilzogg is extremely dangerous. He is reportedly holed up in the recently conquered keep plotting the Blackrock clan's further crimes against humanity. The orc infestation must be quelled at all costs. A gracious reward will be given to whatever brave soul can deliver the head of Gath'Ilzogg to Magistrate Solomon.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What do you have there, traveler?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Fantastic work, friend! Gath'Ilzogg led those brutes into battle, killing many innocent humans. Vindication is ours. This is the first step in reclaiming the keep for the kingdom of Stormwind!
